dataQuality/testDefinitions.name: columnValuesToBeNotNull
dataQuality/testDefinitions.displayName: Column Values To Be Not Null
dataQuality/testDefinitions.description: This schema defines the test ColumnValuesToBeNotNull. Test the number of values in a column are null. Values must be explicitly null. Empty strings don't count as null.

parameterDefinition.name: threshold
parameterDefinition.description: Number of failures tolerated before the test is marked as failed. Read as an absolute count or as a percentage depending on `thresholdUnit` (defaults to 0).

parameterDefinition.name: thresholdUnit
parameterDefinition.description: How to read `threshold`: `ABSOLUTE` for a raw count of failures, `PERCENTAGE` for a share of the evaluated rows (defaults to ABSOLUTE).

parameterDefinition.name: dimensionFailurePolicy
parameterDefinition.description: How dimensional results roll up into the overall test status: `OVERALL_ONLY` only looks at the overall result, `ANY_DIMENSION` fails the test as soon as one dimension fails (defaults to OVERALL_ONLY).

parameterDefinition.name: minRowsPerDimension
parameterDefinition.description: Under the `ANY_DIMENSION` policy and a `PERCENTAGE` threshold, a dimension with fewer rows than this is still evaluated and reported, but does not fail the test (defaults to 0: every dimension counts).

dataQuality/testDefinitions.name: columnValuesToBeUnique
dataQuality/testDefinitions.description: This schema defines the test ColumnValuesToBeUnique. Test the values in a column to be unique.

parameterDefinition.name: threshold
parameterDefinition.description: Number of failures tolerated before the test is marked as failed. Read as an absolute count or as a percentage depending on `thresholdUnit` (defaults to 0).

parameterDefinition.name: thresholdUnit
parameterDefinition.description: How to read `threshold`: `ABSOLUTE` for a raw count of failures, `PERCENTAGE` for a share of the evaluated rows (defaults to ABSOLUTE).

parameterDefinition.name: dimensionFailurePolicy

parameterDefinition.name: minRowsPerDimension
parameterDefinition.description: Under the `ANY_DIMENSION` policy and a `PERCENTAGE` threshold, a dimension with fewer rows than this is still evaluated and reported, but does not fail the test (defaults to 0: every dimension counts).

dataQuality/testDefinitions.description: This schema defines the test TableRowCountToEqual. Test the number of rows equal to a value.

apps/marketplace.name: CacheWarmupApplication
apps/marketplace.description: OpenMetadata uses Redis cache to improve performance for frequently accessed entities. This application pre-loads entities into the cache to optimize read performance.
apps/marketplace.features: Pre-warm Redis cache with entity data, references, and tags. Supports distributed locking to ensure only one instance runs across multiple servers.

apps/marketplace.name: DataContractValidationApplication
apps/marketplace.description: The Data Contract Validation application is designed to validate data contracts and ensure compliance with your standards. It ensures schemas, semantics, and data quality are maintained across your data assets.
apps/marketplace.features: Run the Data Contract validation at a schedule.

apps/marketplace.name: DataInsightsApplication
apps/marketplace.description:
**Data Insights: A Revolutionary Tool for Metadata Analysis and Data Management**

**Comprehensive Data Analytics:** Dive deep into the world of data with our advanced analytics, crafted to transform raw metadata into valuable insights. The application meticulously processes collected metadata, ensuring every bit of information is utilized to its full potential.
**Growth Trend Identification:** Stay ahead of the curve by tracking the expansion of your data assets over time. Our application provides a visual and quantitative analysis of your data’s growth rate, helping you make informed decisions for resource allocation and future planning.
**Detailed Asset Descriptions and Ownership:** Gain clarity on your data landscape with extensive descriptions and clear ownership details for each data asset. Our tool not only lists the data assets but also enriches them with metadata, ensuring that you have a comprehensive understanding of what each dataset entails and who is responsible for it.
**OpenMetadata Integration:** Experience seamless integration with OpenMetadata, one of the leading metadata platforms. Our application taps into the power of OpenMetadata to fetch, analyze, and visualize usage patterns, ensuring that you are leveraging OpenMetadata to its full potential.
**User Interaction Tracking:** Discover which data assets are capturing the attention of your users. Our tool keeps track of user interactions, pinpointing the most viewed and utilized data assets. This feature is invaluable for identifying popular datasets, helping you to understand user preferences and trends.
**Actionable Insights for Data Governance:** Beyond analytics, our application serves as a tool for robust data governance. By providing insights into data asset utilization, ownership, and growth, it empowers organizations to enforce better data management practices, ensuring data quality and integrity.
User-Friendly Interface: Navigate through a wealth of data with ease, thanks to our intuitive and user-friendly interface. Even if you are not a data expert, our application provides a straightforward experience, making data analytics accessible to everyone.
**Real-Time Analytics:** Stay up-to-date with real-time analytics and insights. Our application ensures that you are always in the loop, providing timely and accurate data to support your decision-making processes.
**Customizable Reports:** Tailor the analytics to suit your needs. With customizable reports, you can focus on the metrics that matter the most to your organization, ensuring that the insights you receive are relevant and actionable.
Secure and Reliable: Trust in the reliability and security of our application. We prioritize the safety of your data, implementing robust security measures to protect your metadata and insights.
Data Insights stands out as a pivotal tool for organizations aiming to optimize their data management practices, ensuring that every piece of data is a stepping stone towards informed decisions and enhanced data governance.
apps/marketplace.features: Run Ingestion Framework Data Insight Module.

apps/marketplace.name: DataInsightsReportApplication
apps/marketplace.description:
**Data Insights Reports: Enhancing Data Management through OpenMetadata**

**Integration with OpenMetadata:** Data Insights Reports is designed to work seamlessly with OpenMetadata, providing organizations with the tools they need to set and track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) such as Ownership and Description Coverage. These KPIs help establish clear goals for data management across the organization.

**Focus on Ownership and Description Coverage:**
     **Ownership:** Knowing who is responsible for each data asset is crucial. By making Ownership a KPI, we help ensure that there is clear accountability for every piece of data, which in turn helps in its proper management.
    **Description Coverage:** It’s important for data to be easily understandable. Setting Description Coverage as a KPI ensures that all data assets are accompanied by clear descriptions, making them more accessible and useful to everyone in the organization.

**Weekly Email Reminders to Stay on Track:**
    **Regular Updates:** Our weekly email reminders keep all teams in the loop, helping them stay aware of their progress in achieving the organization’s KPIs.
Visual Progress Tracking: The emails include visual representations of progress, making it easy for teams to quickly understand where they stand in relation to the set goals.
    **Guidance for Action:** The updates are not just about tracking progress; they also provide insights and suggestions on what can be done to improve, ensuring that teams have the guidance they need to meet their goals.

**Supporting Teams and Advancing Organizational Goals:**
    **Building a Data-Driven Culture:** By integrating KPI tracking into regular workflows, Data Insights Reports helps cultivate a culture that values and leverages data for better decision-making.
    **Tailored to Each Team:** While Ownership and Description Coverage are universal goals, our tool recognizes that each team is different. The weekly reports are customized to suit the specific needs and characteristics of each team, ensuring that the insights provided are always relevant.
In summary, Data Insights Reports provides a practical and effective solution for organizations looking to enhance their data management practices. Through integration with OpenMetadata, regular updates, and a focus on key data management goals, it supports teams in their efforts to maintain clear ownership and comprehensive descriptions of their data assets.
apps/marketplace.features: Data Insights Application. Send Email Reports.

apps/marketplace.name: DataRetentionApplication
apps/marketplace.description:
The Data Retention App automates the cleanup of OpenMetadata's internal database to maintain performance and efficiency. Based on customizable retention periods and admin-defined retention policies, this application helps manage rapidly growing tables and prevents data bloat by removing outdated records.

**Efficient Record Management:** The Retention Policy App automates the cleanup and deletion of records for selected entities based on specified retention durations. It simplifies compliance with data retention policies and ensures efficient database management.

apps/marketplace.description: Example external application to demonstrate the use of pipelines.

apps/marketplace.name: McpApplication
apps/marketplace.features: Sets up a embedded server for MCP (Metadata Collection Protocol) to interact with OpenMetadata via SSE/Streamable-Http transport.

apps/marketplace.name: RdfIndexApp
apps/marketplace.description: OpenMetadata connects with RDF triple stores (Apache Jena Fuseki, QLever) to provide Knowledge Graph capabilities. This application synchronizes data from OpenMetadata to RDF format.
apps/marketplace.features: Sync OpenMetadata entities and relationships to RDF triple stores, enabling Knowledge Graph visualization and SPARQL queries.

apps/marketplace.description: Materializes enabled inference rules into durable per-rule named graphs inside Apache Jena Fuseki.
apps/marketplace.features: Durable dirty-state tracking, zero-JVM-triple CONSTRUCT execution, and per-rule inferred named graphs.

apps/marketplace.description: OpenMetadata connects with Elastic/Open Search to provide search feature for Data Assets. This application provides additional features related to ES/OS.
apps/marketplace.features: Sync OpenMetadata and Elastic Search with staged index promotion.

relationshipTypes.description: General association between concepts that are semantically connected.
relationshipTypes.name: relatedTo

relationshipTypes.description: Concepts that have the same meaning and can be used interchangeably.
relationshipTypes.name: synonym

relationshipTypes.description: This concept is a part or component of another concept.
relationshipTypes.name: partOf

relationshipTypes.description: This concept contains another concept as a part or component.
relationshipTypes.name: hasPart

relationshipTypes.description: This concept or metric is calculated or derived from another concept.
relationshipTypes.name: calculatedFrom

relationshipTypes.description: This concept is used in the calculation of another concept or metric.
relationshipTypes.name: usedToCalculate

relationshipTypes.description: A related concept that may provide additional context.
relationshipTypes.name: seeAlso

relationshipTypes.description: Every instance of this concept is also an instance of the target concept. Unlike broader, this asserts subsumption, so the target's attributes apply to this concept.
relationshipTypes.name: subClassOf

relationshipTypes.description: Every instance of the target concept is also an instance of this concept.
relationshipTypes.name: superClassOf

dataQuality/dimensions.name: Accuracy
dataQuality/dimensions.description: Values correctly represent the real-world facts they describe.

dataQuality/dimensions.name: Completeness
dataQuality/dimensions.description: Expected values are present — no unexpected nulls or missing rows.

dataQuality/dimensions.name: Consistency
dataQuality/dimensions.description: The same fact agrees across tables, systems and time.

dataQuality/dimensions.name: Integrity
dataQuality/dimensions.description: Relationships between tables and keys hold as declared.

dataQuality/dimensions.name: SQL
dataQuality/dimensions.description: Custom SQL assertions that do not fit another dimension.

dataQuality/dimensions.name: Uniqueness
dataQuality/dimensions.description: Records are free of unintended duplicates.

dataQuality/dimensions.name: Validity
dataQuality/dimensions.description: Values conform to the expected type, format or allowed set.
